commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Dr. Eggman ({2}{U}{B}{R} 3/6 flying legendary Human Scientist; sld, released 2025-07-14; commander-legal, not a Game Changer): at the beginning of our end step, draw a card, then each opponent in turn order (701.55d) faces a villainous choice (701.55a): discard a card, or we may put a Construct, Robot or Vehicle card from hand onto the battlefield. An empty-handed opponent may choose discard and discard nothing (701.55b). Put is not cast (no cast triggers or cost reductions); enters triggers fire (603.6a); Vehicles are not crewed when put. The Valeyard makes opponents face each choice an additional time (701.55c), which multiplies choices, not draws. Roaming Throne (Scientist/Human), Spark Double, Strionic Resonator and Y'shtola Rhul multiply triggers to at most 9 per turn (mechanics test). Plan: fill the hand with payloads, punish discards (Caress, Waste Not, Geth's Grimoire, Tinybones, Entropic Battlecruiser), and win with large artifact bodies.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 4 (Optimized). Game Changers: 3 in baseline and candidate (Ancient Tomb, Cyclonic Rift, Fierce Guardianship). Commander Spellbook find-my-combos: 0 included combos for both lists (almost-included 36 -> 30). No infinite is claimed; trigger multipliers are finite (max 9 Eggman triggers per turn).
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first: every add is a Construct, Robot or Vehicle that Eggman's own Oracle can put from hand, and all five have enters or dies value that works when put (Su-Chi's is on death). Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis decks, baseline -> candidate): Davros, Dalek Creator 45 -> 43; Mishra, Eminent One 41 -> 41; Mishra, Artificer Prodigy 40 -> 39; Ashnod the Uncaring 38 -> 37; The Valeyard 35 -> 34; Mai and Zuko 37 -> 35. Disclosed honestly: the shared core is mostly mana base, rocks and premium interaction; separation is commander-first: Eggman rewards having Construct/Robot/Vehicle cards in hand at the end step, so every add is a payload. Owner-removed classes (the 2026-10-14 removals and rejections: Megrim and additional discard punishment such as Raiders' Wake, anthems such as Steel Overseer and Chief of the Foundry, Etherium Sculptor, Mirrorworks, Torrential Gearhulk, Imposter Mech, Scrawling Crawler, Damocles Base) are not re-added and are judged REJECT. Two cuts (Blasphemous Act, Foundry Inspector) contradict the owner's explicit retention and are flagged, with keep-each alternatives staged.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps:
All 99 library cards were reviewed by quantity (96 library rows: 2x Island, 2x Mountain, 2x Swamp, everything else 1x).
Roles:
- 31 lands: Ancient Tomb, Command Tower, City of Brass, Mana Confluence, Exotic Orchard, Training Center, Luxury Suite, Morphic Pool, Xander's Lounge, Underground Sea, Volcanic Island, Badlands, Watery Grave, Blood Crypt, Steam Vents, Polluted Delta, Scalding Tarn, Bloodstained Mire, Academy Ruins, Urza's Saga, Inventors' Fair, Spire of Industry, Seat of the Synod, Vault of Whispers, Great Furnace, 6 basics.
- Rocks: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, Mox Opal, three Talismans.
- Commander multipliers: Roaming Throne, Spark Double, Strionic Resonator, Y'shtola Rhul, The Valeyard.
- Discard payoffs (exactly five): Liliana's Caress, Waste Not, Geth's Grimoire, Tinybones, Entropic Battlecruiser.
- Payloads (Construct/Robot/Vehicle): 28 in baseline, 31 in candidate.
- Recursion/tutors to hand: Academy Ruins, Golbez, Scrap Trawler, Tezzeret, Fabricate, Scrapyard Recombiner, Interceptor Mechan (new).
- Interaction: Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Deflecting Swat, Deadly Rollick, Chaos Warp, Withering Torment, Cyclonic Rift, Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death; Blasphemous Act (cut).
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Baseline and candidate: 31 lands (6 basics), 7 rocks plus Ancient Tomb; average nonland MV 4.206 -> 4.221; creatures 33 -> 33; instants/sorceries 13 -> 12; payloads 28 -> 31. Exact multivariate-hypergeometric DP (mechanics test): P(5 lands by card 11/12) 0.2289/0.3032 and P(Eggman castable on lands+rocks with U, B and R) 0.3751/0.4696, unchanged by the preferred five; 32 lands 0.2539/0.3328 and 0.404/0.5009; 33 lands 0.2798/0.3631 and 0.4333/0.532. P(no payload in 7 cards) 0.0893 -> 0.0651; in 12 cards 0.0139 -> 0.0079.
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Stack: Fierce Guardianship, Mana Drain, Deflecting Swat. Removal: Deadly Rollick, Chaos Warp, Withering Torment, plus payload removal (Possession Engine and Skysovereign new; Behemoth of Vault 0 on death; Cityscape Leveler; Demonic Junker; Noxious Gearhulk). Wipes: Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death, Cyclonic Rift (Blasphemous Act cut). Protection: Padeem, Lightning Greaves (Cryptothrall cut). Weak points: Eggman is a 5-mana commander that needs to survive to the end step; graveyard hate blunts recursion; opponents with empty hands answer every choice for free (40/64 cells of the bounded grid give at least one free out).

whole_deck_audit.current_baseline_strength: An approved Bracket 4 Eggman list (2026-10-14) built on end-step payload puts and discard punishment. M6 Pass C (#15) final NEEDS TESTING, KEEP (owner-equivalent substitute, NOT independent; 0 measured playtests); it asked for bounded tests of +Goblin Welder/-Liliana's Caress, 31 vs 32/33 lands, and cast-vs-put multipliers. material_candidates.source: EDHREC Dr. Eggman general 1688/13580, upgraded 117/1056, optimized 20/255; live Scryfall batch
material_candidates.role: {3}{U}{U} Vehicle 5/5, crew 3: when it enters, gain control of target creature an opponent controls for as long as we control the Vehicle; that creature can't attack or block.
material_candidates.incumbent_opportunity_cost: Loses Blasphemous Act (symmetric 13-damage wipe), one of four board resets with Toxic Deluge, Their Name Is Death and Cyclonic Rift. FLAG: contradicts the owner's explicit 2026-10-14 retention of Blasphemous Act in the interaction suite; a keep-Act four-swap is staged.
material_candidates.commander_synergy: A Vehicle, so Eggman can put it from hand at the end step when an opponent declines to discard; its enters trigger still fires when put (603.6a), so the opponent who refuses to discard loses their best creature. It is not crewed when put (301.7a), but the theft does not need it to be a creature.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Theft ends if the Vehicle leaves; the stolen creature can't attack or block for us; Blasphemous Act was the cheapest answer to a wide board. FLAG: the owner listed Blasphemous Act in the retained premium interaction suite on 2026-10-14; a four-swap list keeping Act is staged.
material_candidates.reason: Turns the put branch of Eggman's villainous choice into removal; a wipe that also kills Eggman and our Constructs/Robots is the worst-fitting interaction slot; Their Name Is Death (destroy all nonartifact creatures) remains and spares our artifact creatures.

Payloads 28 -> 31; 31 lands unchanged.

low_swap_heightened_audit.alternate_cuts_for_prior_holds: Pass C's +Goblin Welder/-Liliana's Caress and 31 vs 32/33 land questions were run as bounded finite tests; both are staged as complete six-swap 100s and rejected (Pass C KEEP and the owner's 31 lands are respected). The owner-retained Blasphemous Act and Foundry Inspector each have a staged keep-it alternative.
low_swap_heightened_audit.strongest_argument_against_baseline: Eggman rewards having Construct, Robot and Vehicle cards in hand at the end step, yet five baseline slots were non-payloads or cast-only: a wipe that kills Eggman, a 7-mana Cyberman, a cast-only cost reducer, an untap artifact and a redundant hexproof Construct.
low_swap_heightened_audit.evidence_based_answer: Five swaps, all payloads Eggman can put: two with enters removal (Possession Engine, Skysovereign), one with hand refill (Interceptor Mechan), and two resilient large bodies (Su-Chi Cave Guard, Behemoth of Vault 0). Payloads 28 -> 31; mana unchanged. Spellbook: 0 included combos before and after.

open_ended_optimization_audit.remaining_99_review: The five-swap floor was reached with five swaps that each stand on their own; the floor was not used as a target and no sixth swap cleared the bar. Every remaining incumbent was re-read against the candidate pool: twelve post-floor challenges were recorded and rejected on Eggman-specific grounds, and three six-swap packages (Pass C's Goblin Welder over Liliana's Caress; Tergrid over Liliana's Caress; Pass C's 32 lands with Silverbluff Bridge over Thoughtcast) are staged as complete 100s.

post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Bounded 192-cell grid: Caress live in 72 cells and drains up to 12 per trigger with The Valeyard; Welder live in 64 and never puts a card into hand, so it doesn't feed Eggman. Pass C KEEP stands.
Tergrid is the stronger discard payoff but Game Changer #4, cast-only and not an Eggman payload; owner rejected additional discard punishment.
32 lands lifts P(Eggman castable by card 12) 0.4696 -> 0.5009 (exact DP), at the cost of a draw-two; the owner deliberately kept 31.
Orchard is usually three colours in multiplayer; Drossforge enters tapped with two.
Shuttle's villainous choice lets the opponent sacrifice their worst creature, the permissive outcome the owner rejected in Damocles Base.
Leveler loses only its cast trigger when put; its attack trigger and unearth beat a vanilla 9/9.
Team flying is the deck's evasion; the Pass C timing note concerns only its enters animation.
Opal is zero mana and makes any colour with metalcraft; hand size rarely binds with one Eggman draw per turn.
Rollick is free with Eggman out; the opponent chooses the softer branch of This Is How It Ends.

post_floor_challenges.incumbent: Blitzwing, Cruel Tormentor // Blitzwing, Adaptive Assailant
post_floor_challenges.tradeoff: Blitzwing's end-step trigger matches Eggman's step; Starscream needs the monarch.
Krang doubles only draw-caused triggers; Eggman's end-step trigger is not one, and Fabricator is a payload already.
Craterclaw's enters pump is wasted when Eggman puts it at end step; Metalwork Colossus recurs itself to hand.

larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Bounded grid: Welder live in 64/192 cells vs Caress 72/192, and Welder puts onto the battlefield, never into hand, so it doesn't feed Eggman; Pass C KEEP.

larger_swap_packages.why_not_selected: Game Changer #4, cast-only (not a Construct/Robot/Vehicle), and the owner rejected adding discard punishment; Tergrid replaces Caress rather than adding a sixth punisher.

open_ended_optimization_audit.quality_based_stop_reason: Stopped at five. Each remaining weak-looking slot beats its best challenger on Eggman-specific grounds: Liliana's Caress is live in more cells than Goblin Welder (bounded grid) and Tergrid would be Game Changer #4; 31 lands is the owner's deliberate count; Orchard, Opal and Rollick are more efficient than their challengers; the remaining owner-rejected classes stay out.
